request.event_key: stable WMS completion/count event ID; empty on receive
request.number: external document number or count event number
request.message: raw ERP object on receive/response, empty otherwise
request.operation: configured operation code on response, empty otherwise

candidates.receive: raw rows from the configured top-level ERP array; single-level for candidate in candidates
candidates.complete: actual completed rows: external_line_id, product_code, quantity, cumulative_quantity, acknowledged_quantity, planned_quantity, uom, lot, source_code, destination_code, package
candidates.inventory: difference rows: product_code, uom, lot, location_code, package, owner_code, book_quantity, counted_quantity, difference_quantity
candidates.response: same frozen rows as the outgoing event

receive_candidates: Fixed adapter exposes message.lines as candidates; vendor arrays may be configured using inbound_lines_key (one top-level key).

lines.uom: exact product stock unit name with lang=None (canonical, not translated)

actions.headers?: optional map; $app_key / $app_secret placeholders, no literal credentials

syntax: bounded JSON assignments, if/else, for candidate in candidates, .get, .append, str/int/float/len; no ORM/import/network
fixed_rules: existing product and stock unit only
same external ID + same normalized content returns existing document
changed external content is rejected for manual review
stock validation creates durable events without HTTP
each partial picking reports only its actual quantity
ordered steps, completed steps never resent
